objections.gloss: The objection loses on the burden before any evidence is heard. A sex-role assigned at birth was assigned without the assignee's assent — and an ascription no one consented to cannot be the thing a…
objections.title: The burden is on the trans person to justify departing from their natal sex. Absent a successful justification — metaphysical (that one can change sex) or therapeutic (that intervention is medically necessary) — there is no right to transition; the default is to remain as assigned.
